meta.name: CCNL Metalmeccanici e Installatori di Impianti (Federmeccanica-Assistal)

family.reason: Federmeccanica/Assistal agreement for the metalworking industry, the reference text of the family.

notes.text: CONSOLIDATED MINIMUMS: the values in base_salary are the 'consolidated table minimums' of the CCNL Federmeccanica-Assistal, which incorporate base pay, contingenza, and EDR into a single figure (Federmeccanica practice since 2001). For this reason fixed_allowances is empty for all levels.
JUNE 2025 TRANCHE: values read in the signed minutes of 12 June 2025 (Federmeccanica, Assistal, Fim, Fiom, Uilm), all 9 levels.

JUNE 2024 AND JUNE 2026 TRANCHES: June 2024 read in the signed minutes of 11 June 2024; June 2026 in the renewal of 22 November 2025 (ratified by the referendum of 18-20 February 2026), whose June 2026 tranche absorbs the IPCA share set by the minutes of 16 June 2026.

SENIORITY INCREMENTS: the proposal to replace monthly increments with a one-off 'early settlement' was rejected in the 2025-2028 negotiations (renewal of 22 November 2025). Increments remain recurring monthly additions under Art. 6, Sez. Quarta Tit. IV, of the CCNL of 5 February 2021 (physical pp. 175-176), where the amounts by level are read.

APPRENTICESHIP: professionalizzante (accordo integrativo 20/04/2021). Eligible levels: D2, C1, C2, C3, B1, B2, B3 (D1 and A1 excluded). Pay: 85% (first third), 90% (second third), 95% (third third), then classified at destination. Three duration tracks: 36m (standard), 30m (diploma EQF 4-7 consistent with profession), 24m (D2 serial repetitive production only). Source: accordo 20/04/2021 Federmeccanica art. 'Apprendistato professionalizzante', reproduced in MySolution circolare Marini 13/05/2021.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 173 hours/month (40 h/week × 52/12 = 173.33 rounded to 173, Federmeccanica standard).
MONTHLY PAYMENTS: 13 (thirteenth month). The fourteenth month is not provided for in the Federmeccanica CCNL. The performance bonus/variable company element is not modelled (layer 3).

INPS: the employer rates of contribution/2026/industria.json for an impiegato are IVS 23.81% plus 4.65% up to 15 employees (28.46%), plus 5.25% from 16 to 50 (29.06%) and plus 5.55% from 51 (29.36%); the cost table of the Ministry of Labour of June 2026 (DD 82 of 5 October 2026) applies 29.36%. INAIL (4.417% in that table) is not computed by the engine (review of 2026-10-30)
JUN 2021, JUN 2022, JUN 2023 TRANCHES: read in the CCNL of 5 February 2021 and the signed minutes of 16 June 2023; four annual tranches (June 2021-2024) under the IPCA mechanism of the 2021 CCNL.

OVERTIME/NIGHT/HOLIDAY: Art. 7 Sez. Quarta Titolo III of the CCNL of 5 February 2021 (physical pp. 160-161): for work not in shifts, overtime 25% for the first two hours and 30% after, night overtime 50%, holiday overtime 55%, night holiday overtime 75%, as the overtime bands model. The renewal of 22 November 2025 leaves the percentages of art. 7 ("Omissis", p. 35 of the signed scan) and adds only the 8% of the quote esenti (note below).

SICKNESS (Sez. Quarta Titolo VI Art. 2): full pay for the first 122/153/214 days of the treatment chain and 80% after, by seniority band (up to 3 years, 3 to 6, over 6); comporto breve of 183/274/365 days over the sickness of the three years that end on the day; the chain restarts after 61 days of work; the first 3 days of the fourth short absence (at most 5 days) of a calendar year are paid 66%, of the fifth and later 50%. The history before the imported episodes, the seniority and the exemption of a short absence are facts: when they could change a sick day the run has a missing_fact blocker.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: OVERTIME, QUOTE ESENTI: the 2025 ipotesi (p. 35) adds 8% to the overtime hours worked beyond the exempt quota of 40 or 48 hours a year; the engine does not count the overtime hours of the year, so it does not add it.

limitation.remediation: Count the overtime hours of the year and add 8% past the exempt quota, or pass the multiplier on the overtime event.

notes.text: TRAVEL AND ON-CALL ALLOWANCES (Art. 7 Trasferta p. 61, Art. 6 Reperibilità p. 158 of the CCNL 2021; adjusted each June by IPCA per the renewal of 22 November 2025, p. 2): event-driven. From 1 June 2026 (minutes of 16 June 2026): trasferta intera 51.29, pasto 13.13, pernottamento 25.03; reperibilità by level group D1-D2-C1 / C2-C3 / B1+ per 16h worked day, 24h rest day, 24h holiday and per week. A StandbyEvent is paid at the rates of work_rules.standby_rules (from 1 June 2025; the earlier rates are not extracted) plus 5.00 for each call; a TravelAllowanceEvent pays the daily_amount the caller states, since the file holds no trasferta amounts (review of 2026-10-30)

SHIFT WORK AND MULTI-WEEK SCHEDULE: the shift column of Art. 7 (night overtime 40% for the first two hours and 45% after, night holiday overtime 65%; night shift work 20%, 60% and 35% from 1 June 2013, 25%, 65% and 40% from 22 to 6) and the premiums of the orario plurisettimanale of Art. 5 as renewed on 22 November 2025 (15% Monday to Friday and 25% on Saturday, 20% and 30% for sudden needs, raised by 8% from the 81st hour, p. 32 of the signed scan) are not modelled: an overtime event of a shift worker or of a multi-week schedule takes the non-shift bands.

limitation.remediation: Model the shift column of Art. 7 and the multi-week premiums of Art. 5 with a fact naming the schedule of the worker, then remove this note.

notes.text: PART-TIME SUPPLEMENTARY HOURS: supplementary work up to 40 hours a week is paid with an all-inclusive 10% (CCNL 5 February 2021, p. 58). The request has no kind for supplementary hours: an overtime event of a part-time worker takes the overtime bands unless the caller passes the multiplier.

limitation.remediation: Resolved: OvertimeKind.SUPPLEMENTARY selects the OT_SUPPLEMENTARE band of the CCNL rate (tests/integration/ccnl_engine/working_time/overtime/test_supplementary.py); the higher rate past the yearly limit is not modelled.

notes.text: ELEMENTO PEREQUATIVO: the worker of a company without second-level bargaining is owed the elemento perequativo of 485 euro a year, paid with the June pay (Ministry of Labour cost table of June 2026, DD 82/2026, row A). The engine does not pay it: whether the company has second-level bargaining is not in the request.

limitation.remediation: Pass the elemento perequativo as a variable pay item, or add a fact for the second-level bargaining.

notes.text: APPRENTICESHIP TRACKS (CCNL 5 February 2021, accordo sull'apprendistato, pp. 267-271): 36 months, reduced by 6 months for a diploma of level 4 QEQ or above (30), 24 for the D2 figures on assembly lines; each third at 85, 90 and 95% of the destination level.

HOURLY RATE AND SUPPLEMENTS (Art. 7 Sez. Quarta Tit. III of the CCNL of 5 February 2021, rates untouched by the renewal of 22 November 2025): without a caller value the engine derives the hourly base (minimi, scatti and fixed allowances over 173) and the supplements on holiday hours (50%) and on holiday hours with a compensatory rest (10%), equal in both columns. Whether those hours are also paid on top of the monthly pay is not settled: a derived holiday supplement is provisional. Not derived, the caller states the amount: ordinary night work (20% until 22 and 30% after; shift workers 15%, 20% from June 2013, 25% from 22 to 6 in the impiantistica), because its window starts 12 hours after the morning shift of each work group and its rate depends on the hour and on the shift column, facts the request does not carry; night holiday work and Sunday work. Individual elements (merito, superminimi, cottimi) are not in the hourly base. Absences: no clause sets the divisor of an absence deduction; the 1/26 of art. 9 (festività on a Sunday) is taken by analogy (work_rules.absence_rules derived, was verified on the wrong clause): the caller states AbsenceEvent.hourly_rate.

LEAVE, PAR (Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 5): 124 hours in the settore siderurgico, 8 more hours for the turnisti on 15 or more shifts a week with night or weekend work and for the workers of the sottosettori of the accordo 1 September 1983 in force at 31 December 2012. The engine accrues the 104 hours of the generalità.

limitation.remediation: Add employment facts for the settore siderurgico, the shift pattern and the sottosettori.

notes.text: LEAVE, CONTO ORE (Art. 5): the PAR not taken in the year go to an individual conto ore for 24 more months and are then paid with the retribuzione in atto. The engine carries the balances and does not pay them at the end of the window.

limitation.remediation: Pay the residual PAR of a year at the end of its 24-month conto ore window.

notes.text: LEAVE AT TERMINATION (Art. 10): the indemnity of a day of ferie is the 'retribuzione giornaliera globale di fatto'; the texts read do not state its divisor of the monthly pay, so the engine pays no residual (termination_residual_leave incomplete, termination_basis_not_sourced).

location.section: Sez. Quarta, Titolo IV, Art. 15 - Previdenza complementare
location.quote: Per i lavoratori di nuova adesione dopo il 5 febbraio 2021 e con età inferiore ai 35 anni compiuti, la contribuzione a carico del datore di lavoro, a decorrere dal 1° giugno 2022, è elevata al 2,2% dei minimi contrattuali.

provenance.transformation: Employer 2% (2.2% for a young member) and worker minimum 1.2% of the minimi contrattuali, the base salary of the level, which in the bundle is the consolidated minimum with contingenza and EDR; a worker rate above 1.2% on the TFR base. The 40% TFR quota of a worker employed before 28.04.1993 is not modelled (PensionFundEnrolment.tfr_to_fund is all or nothing).
provenance.note: Art. 15 is not amended by the ipotesi of 22 November 2025 (sha256 37152685..., which changes art. 17 Welfare only). The Cometa nota informativa in force from 31/07/2026 (https://www.cometafondo.it/parte-i-scheda-iii-i-destinatari-e-i-contributi) gives the same rates and the bases: Lavoratori occupati dopo il 28.04.1993 100% 1,2% 2%; (1) Il contributo a carico datore di lavoro è calcolato percentualmente sul valore dei minimi contrattuali del livello di inquadramento del lavoratore aderente. [...] per i lavoratori di nuova adesione dopo il 5 febbraio 2021 e con età inferiore ai 35 anni compiuti, prevede che la contribuzione a carico del datore di lavoro, a decorrere dal 1° g Verified on 2026-10-14: art. 15 re-read in the CCNL of 5 February 2021 (sha256 ff182dd8..., physical pp. 182-183): 'A decorrere dal 1° giugno 2017 [...] un'aliquota pari al 2% dei minimi contrattuali', the worker 'almeno pari all'1,2% del minimo contrattuale', and 2,2% from 1 June 2022 for members joining after 5 February 2021 under 35.

location.quote: Per i suddetti lavoratori è prevista a decorrere dal 1° ottobre 2017 una contribuzione pari a 156 euro annui (suddivisi in 12 quote mensili da 13 euro l'una) a totale carico dell'azienda comprensiva delle coperture per i familiari fiscalmente a carico

provenance.transformation: Also: Ministero del Lavoro, tabelle costo del lavoro metalmeccanica impiegati allegate al DD 82 del 5 ottobre 2026, p. 1: Assistenza sanitaria integr.+ Contrib. Di solidarietà 10%                 171,60 (13 x 12 = 156 + 10% solidarity = 171.60).
provenance.note: Employer only, health fund with 10% INPS solidarity. The ipotesi of 22 November 2025 does not amend art. 16. Covers permanent workers, apprentices and fixed terms of at least 5 months out of probation: the shorter fixed terms, the probation and the written renunciation are not modelled.

health_funds.description: Welfare (flexible benefits), Art. 17 Sez. Quarta Tit. IV

source_document.title: CCNL Federmeccanica-Assistal, Ipotesi di accordo 22 novembre 2025 (siglata, scansione)

location.quote: A decorrere dall'anno 2026, entro il 1° giugno di ciascun anno le aziende dovranno mettere a disposizione dei lavoratori strumenti di welfare, elencati in via esemplificativa in calce al presente articolo, del valore di 250 euro da utilizzare entro il 31 maggio dell'anno successivo. Per il solo anno 2026 l'importo annuale, pari a 250 euro, sarà messo a disposizione entro il mese di febbraio.

provenance.transformation: Also: CCNL Federmeccanica-Assistal 5 febbraio 2021 (testo stampato), p. 185: I suddetti valori sono onnicomprensivi ed espressamente esclusi dalla base di calcolo del trattamento di fine rapporto. ... I suddetti valori non sono riproporzionabili per i lavoratori part-time e sono comprensivi esclusivamente di eventuali costi fiscali o contributivi a carico dell'azienda. Ministero del Lavoro, tabelle costo del lavoro metalmeccanica impiegati allegate al DD 82 del 5 ottobre 2026, p. 1: Flaxible Benefits   250,00
provenance.note: 250 EUR a year made available by February in 2026 and by 1 June from 2027, an employer cost outside the pay, the TFR and the bases (all-inclusive of the employer's tax and contribution costs), not reproportioned for part time. The years before 2026 (200 EUR) and the eligibility conditions (past probation, in force on 1 June or hired by 31 December, fixed terms of 3 months in the year) are not modelled.

hourly_base_provenance.transformation: Art. 3 Sez. Quarta Tit. IV (p. 173) divides by 173 the minimi tabellari (consolidated with contingenza and EDR in base_salary), the scatti, the aumenti di merito and the other compensi fixed by the month, plus the hourly elements: base salary, seniority and fixed allowances. location.quote: l'importo di una quota giornaliera della retribuzione di fatto, pari a 1/26 della retribuzione mensile fissa

provenance.transformation: No clause sets the divisor of an absence deduction; the daily quota of 1/26 of Art. 9 (a festività falling on a Sunday) is taken as the daily quota, the industria convention.
provenance.note: Sez. Quarta Tit. IV Art. 3 (p. 173) sets the hourly pay at 1/173 'ai fini dei vari istituti contrattuali': an hourly deduction would be equally consistent. The engine derives no absence deduction from this rule: the caller states AbsenceEvent.hourly_rate.

location.section: Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 10 - Ferie
location.quote: pari a 4 settimane ... oltre 10 anni e fino a 18 anni compiuti hanno diritto ad un giorno in più ... oltre i 18 anni compiuti hanno diritto ad una settimana in più

provenance.note: Weeks of five working days (20/21/25); a six-day week gives 24/25/30, not modelled. The norme transitorie (p. 167) for workers of the former Disciplina speciale, Parte prima, in force at 31 December 2007 (seniority for the extra days counted from 1 January 2008; one extra day with ten years of service and age 55) are not modelled.

location.section: Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 10 - Ferie
location.quote: La frazione di mese superiore ai 15 giorni sarà considerata, a questi effetti, come mese intero.

provenance.note: One twelfth of the yearly ferie per month of service, a fraction of more than 15 days counting as a whole month; the days of the year are those of entitlement_tiers (5-day week).

location.section: Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 5 - Permessi annui retribuiti
location.quote: sono riconosciuti ai lavoratori, in ragione di anno di servizio ed in misura proporzionalmente ridotta per le frazioni di esso, 13 permessi annui retribuiti di 8 ore (pari a complessive 104 ore, di cui 72 ore precedentemente riconosciute a titolo di riduzione d’orario e 32 ore in sostituzione delle festività abolite).

provenance.note: One PAR pool of 104 hours (72 of reduction and 32 of ex festività). The text reduces the hours 'proporzionalmente' for fractions of a year without a month rule: a partial month accrues nothing and the balance is marked inexact.

source_document.title: CCNL 5 febbraio 2021 per l'industria metalmeccanica privata e della installazione di impianti (testo FIOM-CGIL)

location.quote: alla intera retribuzione globale per i primi 122 giorni di calendario e all'80% della retribuzione globale per i giorni residui

provenance.transformation: Bands from 0, 36 and 72 completed months of recognised seniority (the exact third and sixth anniversary days fall in the higher band), read on the first day of the episode. Treatment chain: the sick days of consecutive episodes, restarted when at least 61 calendar days separate the return to work (the day after the last sick day) from the next episode. Comporto: sick days within the three years that end on the day assessed (FIOM leaflet: sickness on 10 March 2022 counts from 11 March 2019). Short absence: an episode of at most 5 calendar days, counted in the calendar year of its first day; an absence the CCNL exempts is neither reduced nor counted. 66% and 50% stored as 0.66 and 0.50.
provenance.note: The ipotesi di accordo of 22 November 2025 (FIOM scan, Sez. Quarta Titolo VI Art. 2, sha256 b0be0185c1186a4dd9b56483172fdfd3e160ad92a8c0d3a068b097dc816cdee8) keeps the paragraphs quoted ('omissis') and adds, from 1 January 2026, 30/45/60 more days of comporto for a certified disability; Sez. Quarta Titolo I Art. 4 lowers from 36 to 24 months the fixed-term contracts whose periods are scaled. Not modelled, each with a blocker: comporto prolungato and the disability days (days past the comporto breve are left out), the full pay of hospital stays over 10 days (a day at 80% raises an issue), fixed-term scaling. Not modelled and not blocked: the probation period, during which the CCNL treatment is not due ('lavoratore non in prova'). PDF printed pages 196-199 are file pages 200-203. Hospital stays: 'I periodi di ricovero ospedaliero di durata superiore a 10 giorni continuativi sono retribuiti con l'intera retribuzione globale in aggiunta al trattamento economico di cui sopra fino ad un massimo di 61 giorni di calendario' (Sez. Quarta Titolo VI art. 2, p. 198): the reduced days of such a stay are paid in full, at most 61 days, counted from the first day of the stay, days in full pay included (the text does not say whether the 61 days count only the reduced days; this reading pays fewer days in full).

location.section: Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 6 - Reperibilità
location.quote: le parti convengono che i trattamenti economici di cui al presente articolo siano esclusi dalla base di calcolo del trattamento di fine rapporto

provenance.transformation: Bands D1-D2-C1, C2-C3, B1 and above ('superiore al C3' in 2021); the hourly rate is the 16-hour column divided by 16; 5.00 euro for each call followed by an intervention; excluded from the TFR base (art. 2120 c. 2 c.c.). Rates from 1 June 2025 and 1 June 2026 from the IPCA verbali; the 2021 table of p. 155 and the updates of 2022-2024 are not extracted (gap missing).
provenance.note: Not modelled here: the travel time after a call (85% of the ordinary hourly pay) and the intervention hours (overtime or ordinary hours), which take their own events; the 'personale direttivo' is excluded from the standby rules.

location.section: Sez. Quarta, Titolo VIII, Art. 1 - Preavviso di licenziamento e di dimissioni
location.quote: Il rapporto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato non può essere risolto da nessuna delle due parti senza un preavviso i cui termini sono stabiliti come segue a seconda dell'anzianità e della categoria professionale cui appartiene il lavoratore. [...] I termini di disdetta decorrono dal giorno del ricevimento dell'atto di dimissioni o di licenziamento e il periodo di preavviso si calcola dal giorno successivo. La parte che risolve il rapporto senza l'osservanza dei predetti termini di preavviso deve corrispondere all'altra un'indennità pari all'importo della retribuzione per il periodo di mancato preavviso come di seguito stabilito.

provenance.transformation: The two tables of Art. 1: 'Fino a 5 anni' is up to 60 months of service, 'Oltre 5 fino a 10' up to 120, 'Oltre i 10 anni' any longer; B2, B3 and A1 2, 3 and 4 months (2, 3, 4 mensilità); C2, C3 and B1 1 month and 15 days, 2 months, 2 months and 15 days (1.5, 2, 2.5 mensilità); D1, D2 and C1 10 days, 20 days, 1 month (0.33, 0.67, 1 mensilità). The same tables apply to dismissal and resignation.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded; no value was marked verified.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file (94 records) read again in the signed texts: the CCNL of 5 February 2021, the renewal of 22 November 2025 and the minutes of June 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 on the minimi.
findings: 91 records match their source and are verified, and the corrected divisor below is verified too. All 72 salary periods match in amount and dates. Pages are physical PDF pages (the printed page of the 2021 CCNL is four lower).

Ratified: the workers' referendum of 18-20 February 2026 approved the renewal of 22 November 2025 (93.13% in favour); the minutes of 16 June 2026 call it the Accordo di rinnovo 22 novembre 2025. No consolidated final text is published; the minimi of the signed hypothesis are in force.

June 2026: the IPCA share is absorbed in the June 2026 tranche of the renewal, so the minimi already in the file stand; the minutes of 16 June 2026 also set travel and on-call allowances, not modelled.
Corrected: the hourly divisor 173 (Art. 5, Sez. Quarta Tit. IV) is undated in the 2021 CCNL, so it applies from 2021-06-01, not from 2024-06-01.

Left derived: the Cometa rates (2%, 1.2%, 2.2% under 35, Art. 15) match but start on 1 June 2017 and 1 June 2022, not on 2026-01-01; the leave tiers start 'oltre 10 anni' and 'oltre i 18 anni', which the file reads as 120 and 216 months.
Wrong page citations corrected: divisor p. 175, seniority pp. 175-176, daily quota 1/26 p. 164, annual leave p. 165.

reviews.scope: Cometa contribution dates, leave citation, travel and on-call allowances: follow-ups of the review of 2026-10-11.
findings: Cometa: rates confirmed (art. 15 not amended in 2025); the periods started on 2026-01-01, now 1 June 2017 (2% and 1.2%) and, for young members, 2% from 6 February 2021 and 2.2% from 1 June 2022.
Leave: the clause is on p. 165, not p. 158; the norme transitorie on p. 167.
Trasferta and reperibilità (June 2026 amounts) are per event: documented, not paid, as the engine takes no such event.

reviews.scope: Standby (reperibilità): art. 6 Sez. Quarta Titolo III and the IPCA verbali of June 2025 and June 2026.
findings: Standby was documented and not paid: the engine now takes a StandbyEvent and the rates of the three bands from 1 June 2025 and 1 June 2026, read on the page images of the two signed verbali.
Art. 6 excludes the standby pay from the TFR base and pays 5.00 euro for each call with an intervention.

reviews.scope: Hospital stays in the sickness treatment (Sez. Quarta Titolo VI art. 2).
findings: Hospital stays of more than 10 consecutive days are paid in full instead of 80%, up to 61 days: modelled with SicknessEpisode.hospital_stays (hospital_stay of the cumulation).

reviews.scope: P1 audit: minimi of every level for June 2026, 2027 and 2028; Cometa rates (art. 15); overtime percentages (art. 7) against the renewal of 22 November 2025.
findings: The 27 minimi of the table (9 levels from 1 June 2026, 2027 and 2028, p. 2 of the signed scan) match the bundle to the cent.
Cometa: 2% of the employer and 1.2% of the worker from 1 June 2017, 2.2% from 1 June 2022 for members joining after 5 February 2021 under 35: verified.
Overtime: the note cited Art. 14 and 15/20/30% and expected the renewal to change them; the bands follow Art. 7 (25/30/50/55/75%) and the renewal leaves them. Note corrected.
Shift column of Art. 7 and multi-week premiums of Art. 5: not modelled, now declared (shift_and_multiweek_premiums).

reviews.scope: Registry check: CNEL code, name, signatories and term against the 21st CNEL report of CCNLs in force (30 June 2025) and the term clause of the text read in the P1 review.
findings: CNEL C011 matches (Federmeccanica, Assistal with FIM, FIOM, UILM; the report also lists the confederations and CISAL Metalmeccanici as depositors).
Term: the renewal 'decorre dal 22 novembre 2025 ed avrà vigore fino a tutto il 30 giugno 2028' (renewal text, p. 4); the report, older, still shows 30/06/2024.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'part-time, tempo determinato, apprendistato e periodo di prova': the apprenticeship tracks and the part-time supplementary hours of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: Part-time supplementary hours at an all-inclusive 10% (p. 58): declared. The apprenticeship tracks of the accordo of 20 April 2021 were not re-read.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'fondi sanitari, previdenza complementare, bilateralità e quote a carico di lavoratore e datore': the pension, health and bilateral contributions of the file against the text read in the P1 review.
findings: Cometa verified in P1. mètaSalute (156 euro a year plus the 10% solidarity contribution, Ministry of Labour DD 82/2026) is not modelled: declared.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'confrontare lordo, netto e costo azienda con esempi indipendenti': a run of the engine against the cost table of the Ministry of Labour for the CCNL (D.Lgs. 36/2023 art. 41 c. 13).
findings: Impiegato C3 with 3 scatti, June 2026, 51 employees: tabellare 2211.43 and scatti 88.92 a month equal the table (26.537,16 and 1.067,04 a year over 12); the employer INPS rate 29.36% and the tredicesima on tabellare and scatti match; the TFR of the month 158.90 is the table's (tabellare + scatti) / 13.5 less the 0.5% IVS contribution the employer offsets (art. 3 L. 297/1982), which the table does not deduct. Match.

Deviations, with cause and decision: INAIL 4.417% and the health fund (171,60 a year) are capabilities the engine does not compute (documented); Cometa at a 40% enrolment is the table's average, the engine pays it on enrolment; the elemento perequativo (485 euro) and the flexible benefits (250 euro) were neither modelled nor declared: declared. The stale INPS note (30.13/30.20/30.50%) is corrected. No independent net pay example: not compared.

reviews.scope: Checklist item 'part-time, tempo determinato, apprendistato e periodo di prova', re-read on the full text published by a party.
findings: Apprenticeship tracks 36, 30 and 24 months at 85/90/95% (p. 271) and their durations (pp. 267-268) match the three tracks of the file.

reviews.scope: The rate of the supplementary hours of the part-time workers.
findings: Lavoro supplementare (Sez. Quarta, Titolo I, PDF p. 58): 10% onnicomprensiva up to 40 weekly hours and 50% of the yearly part-time hours, 20% beyond that yearly limit. The 10% band is added for OvertimeKind.SUPPLEMENTARY; the 20% past the yearly limit needs the yearly count of supplementary hours and is not modelled.

reviews.scope: Hourly base of the time supplements and the supplements of ordinary night, holiday, Sunday, rest-day and shift work, read in the cited articles of the national text (text layer, or OCR of the scanned pages). AI review only: the same model extracted and checked the values.
findings: hourly_base_method gross_incl_allowances (was minimo_tabellare), now verified: the engine reads it to derive the hourly rate of an event without one.
Supplement bands added: FED_FESTIVO, FED_FESTIVO_RIPOSO.
Bands left out where the rate depends on facts the request does not carry or the text is unconfirmed; listed in the coverage note HOURLY RATE AND SUPPLEMENTS.
work_rules.absence_rules was verified on the 1/26 of art. 9, which pays a festività falling on a Sunday and sets no absence divisor: now derived, with the reading stated.

reviews.scope: Leave accrual: the ferie twelfths and month rule, the hours of each permit bucket (ROL, ex festività or the pooled PAR), the new-hire ramps and the basis of the indemnity for the residual leave at termination, read on the text cited by each rule. An AI review: the extractor is also the verifier.
findings: The values stated are those of the quoted clauses; what the texts leave open (month fractions, termination divisors, schedules and shift patterns) is not modelled and is recorded in the coverage notes.

reviews.scope: The pricing of the seniority increments matured before a change of level (Sez. Quarta, Titolo IV, Art. 6 - Aumenti periodici di anzianità).
findings: Sez. Quarta, Titolo IV, Art. 6 - Aumenti periodici di anzianità (p. 176): the earlier increments take the amounts of the new level from the change: seniority_increments.on_promotion.

reviews.scope: Whether the individual elements of the worker (superminimi, aumenti di merito, assegni ad personam) enter the hourly base of overtime and supplements (Sez. Quarta, Titolo IV, Art. 3 - Mensilizzazione; Titolo III, Art. 7).
findings: Sez. Quarta, Titolo IV, Art. 3 - Mensilizzazione; Titolo III, Art. 7: individual elements included in the hourly base: work_rules.time_supplements.individual_elements.
